info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Quantitative Model Submission API
info.description: The Quantitative Model Submission API allows users to efficiently submit and deploy quantitative financial models for market analysis. This API caters to financial institutions and algorithmic traders who require robust quantitative insights into market data. By interfacing with this API, users can enhance their trading strategies and decision-making processes. The operation supports various model configurations, enabling seamless integration into existing financial platforms.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new quantitative model within the market data system. Users can send the necessary model parameters in the request body to initialize and store a new model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit data for the quant model operation. It expects a structured JSON object that conforms to the specified schema.
